title: Paul McCartney-backed Liverpool arts institute celebrates 400+ graduates 30 years on
summary_full: The LIPA held its 2026 graduation ceremony celebrating its 30th anniversary by awarding degrees to its very first graduates. With over 400 students from 28 different countries in attendance, this event marked a monumental occasion. Sir Paul McCartney was on hand to honor five notable figures for their artistry and impact on the cultural landscape, showcasing LIPA's commitment to nurturing creative talent across various fields, including music, theatre, and film.
